introLocationHeadingFG: Location data helps Dotsin understand mobility patterns, routines, environmental context, and location-based behaviors that contribute to personalized behavioral insights.
introLocationTopDescriptionFG:
• Analyze movement patterns and routines.
• Generate contextual behavioral insights.
• Detect meaningful place transitions and travel patterns.
• Improve behavioral model accuracy through environmental context.
introLocationBtmDescriptionFG:
• Foreground: Display location-aware insights.
• Background: Maintain continuity of movement analysis.
• Terminated: Support significant location updates and continuity of behavioral analytics where supported by the OS.
introLocationHeadingBG: Background location access allows Dotsin to continuously monitor mobility patterns and routines to deliver accurate behavioral insights even when the app is not in use.
introLocationTopDescriptionBG:
• Continuously monitor movement patterns and routines.
• Detect place transitions and travel patterns in real time.
• Maintain uninterrupted behavioral context throughout the day.
introLocationBtmDescriptionBG:
• Foreground: Display live location-aware insights.
• Background: Continuously track movement for uninterrupted behavioral analysis.
• Terminated: Limited location updates may occur depending on OS restrictions.
introHealthHeading: Health data enables Dotsin to correlate physical wellbeing with behavioral patterns, helping users understand the relationship between activity, recovery, health, and daily performance.
introHealthTopDescription:
• Access activity, fitness, sleep, and wellness metrics.
• Generate personalized health insights.
• Identify trends between physical wellbeing and behavior.
• Provide a unified health and behavioral view.
introHealthBtmDescription:
• Foreground: Display current health metrics and insights.
• Background: Synchronize health records and sensor data.
• Terminated: Process scheduled health updates and maintain continuity of long-term analytics.
introScreenHeading: Screen Time data helps users understand digital habits, focus patterns, productivity, and overall relationship with technology.
introScreenTopDescription:
• Measure device and application usage patterns.
• Generate digital wellbeing insights.
• Identify focus, distraction, and engagement behaviors.
• Support healthier digital habits through recommendations.
introScreenBtmDescription:
• Foreground: Display current usage insights.
• Background: Continuously update usage statistics and trends.
• Terminated: Process usage summaries and maintain long-term digital behavior analytics.
introBatteryHeading: Battery Optimization exemption ensures reliable synchronization of Health, Location, Screen Time, and behavioral data required to provide accurate user insights.
introBatteryTopDescription:
• Ensure reliable background synchronization.
• Prevent interruption of behavioral, health, and mobility analytics.
• Guarantee timely delivery of important alerts and reminders.
• Maintain data continuity and reduce missing behavioral records.
introBatteryBtmDescription:
• Foreground: Ensure uninterrupted real-time processing.
• Background: Allow essential synchronization tasks to execute reliably.
• Terminated: Enable operating-system-approved scheduled processing and notifications.
connectorTopDescription: Connect your approved data sources so we can better understand your daily routines, activity, movement, and digital habits.
connectorBtmDescription: This app only helps connect and organize your data. Your personalized insights, reports, and recommendations will be available in the web version.
introNotificationHeading: Notifikasi digunakan untuk memberi tahu pengguna tentang wawasan perilaku penting, pengingat, dan status sinkronisasi data dari Kesehatan, Lokasi, Screen Time, dan sumber data lain yang mendukung pengalaman Dotsin.
introNotificationTopDescription:
• Memberi tahu pengguna ketika data kesehatan, aktivitas, lokasi, atau screen time telah disinkronkan.
• Memperingatkan pengguna jika izin dinonaktifkan atau sinkronisasi terganggu.
• Menginformasikan pengguna tentang data yang hilang yang dapat memengaruhi akurasi wawasan.
• Menyampaikan wawasan perilaku, pengingat, dan rekomendasi kesejahteraan.
• Memberi tahu pengguna ketika optimasi baterai atau pembatasan sistem mencegah sinkronisasi latar belakang.
introNotificationBtmDescription:
• Foreground: Menampilkan status sinkronisasi dan wawasan secara real time.
• Background: Memberi tahu pengguna tentang sinkronisasi yang selesai, kegagalan, atau masalah izin.
• Terminated: Menyampaikan notifikasi sinkronisasi dan pemrosesan penting yang dihasilkan oleh tugas latar belakang terjadwal.
